# <span id="aanchor456"></span> Graph Tool

Accessing this feature requires **Meter Edit** system process privileges.

The Graph Tool allows you to view meter and location data graphically.

<div class="procedure">

To create a graph:

1.  Go to **Tools** \> **Graph Tool**.
    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 606;height: 438;" />  

2.  Click **Select Parameters**.
    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 457;height: 430;" />  

3.  Select whether to graph data for meters or locations, and then select the meter or location for which you want to graph data.

4.  Select whether to graph **Process** parameters (flow data) or **Component** parameters (analysis). To select from all available parameters, select **All**.

5.  If you want to change the plot line color for a parameter, right-click the color and choose from the available colors.

6.  Select the parameters that you want to graph, or click **Check All** to select all of the parameters in the list.

7.  Click **Insert**.

    FLOWCAL lists the parameters that you selected on the right side of the screen.

8.  When you are satisfied with the list of parameters to be plotted, click **OK**.

9.  The name of the meter or location and the selected parameters display on the left side of the Graph Tool.

    When the Traces option (top menu) is set to "On", the Trace checkboxes can be used to trace the plot line. The exact date and values are displayed above the graph as the line is traced.

10. Select the date range and data resolution to plot, and then click **Plot**.

    FLOWCAL displays the data in graphical and tabular format.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

    To zoom in on the graph, click and drag in an area of the graph. To zoom out, double-click the graph.

11. To export the data to an Excel spreadsheet, right-click the table and select **Export to Excel**.

Additional options for formatting the graph (such as changing the scale and selecting a gradient) are available from the menus at the top of the screen.

</div>
